decision.title: Name pool internals (packet )
decision.summary: The name pool keeps URIs, prefixes and names in entry arrays with unseeded FNV-1a open-addressing indexes and text in an arena of 1 KiB blocks, all counted against maximum_byte_count.

body.p: . Three tables (URIs, prefixes, names), each an entry array in issue order plus an open-addressing index (linear probing, at most 3/4 full, slots keep the hash so growth never reads entries); FNV-1a, not seeded: hash flooding is bounded by maximum_byte_count. Interned text lives in an arena placed in the pool's own memory, in 1 KiB blocks. maximum_byte_count counts every allocation the pool holds (tables and whole text blocks, so a pool may stop up to one block early); a replaced table gives its bytes back. A failed intern leaves the pool's names as they were. Interned URI identifiers start at SXML_NAMESPACE_WELL_KNOWN_COUNT; prefix and name identifiers at 1. src/name_internal.h gives sxml_name_pool_name_limit (and URI, prefix) so tables indexed by identifier can be sized.
